ev.q: Sonic Mania is a side-scrolling platformer
Its presentation, level design, music, and faithfulness to the early Sonic games were praised
with branching paths that made multiple playthroughs
collecting all seven Chaos Emeralds allows players to use their character's super transformation
The split-screen competitive multiplayer mode allows two players to race to the end of a level
frustrations with controls and enemy placement in the original Sonic games were present in Sonic Mania
